purpose: why the symbol-shuffle placebo uses --shuffle-symbols-mode relabel and not draw
conclusion: Neither symbol-level shuffle is distribution-matched, and they fail in opposite directions, because news volume is itself a size/liquidity proxy: the per-article uniform `draw` flattens the heavy tail (dispersion 2.18 -> 0.52, the 'no news in 20 sessions' tier 6.1% -> 0.8%), while the fixed-bijection `relabel` under-covers (coverage 69.2% -> 57.2%, that tier 6.1% -> 15.9%) because the bijection is drawn over the 1,237-symbol union universe and routinely maps a well-covered large cap onto a name outside that year's ~977-symbol cohort. `relabel` is the mode this round uses -- it preserves each pseudo-symbol's whole news history verbatim, which is the property a placebo for a persistent count feature needs -- but the control that is exactly size-matched by construction is the within-week state shuffle (kernel/news_gate.shuffle_states_within_date), and that is the one the verdict leans on.
